title: Ship Dễ Agent Brain Lesson
description: One reviewed lesson in the shipde-brain knowledge base. A lesson enters as proposed and only a human review may approve it (AI-TOOL-06); no agent approves its own lesson. An approved lesson carries the exact commit it was learned from, the scope it applies to, an expiry or an explicit null, and a supersession pointer or an explicit null. Expiry and supersession are required keys, never omitted: an unbounded lesson and a lesson that is not yet replaced are both deliberate states that must be written down, so neither can be inferred from a missing field.

id.description: Stable lesson identifier, unique within shipde-brain.

status.description: Only a human review moves a lesson to approved (AI-TOOL-06).

scope.description: Where the lesson applies. A lesson with no scope is not admissible.

source_commit.description: The exact 40-character commit the lesson was learned from.

expiry.description: Date after which the lesson must be re-reviewed, or null when it is not time-bounded.

superseded_by.description: The lesson that replaced this one, or null when nothing has.

evidence.description: The observation the lesson was derived from, in the repository rather than in a chat.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the lesson was recorded.

proposed_by.description: The agent or human that proposed the lesson.

approved_by.description: The human who approved it, or null while it is proposed.
